legend.derives: Every listed premise is jointly required for the stated inference, within the cited source.
legend.attacks: The premises furnish a counterexample or limitation of the target assertion.
legend.checks: Finite executable evidence supports an implementation only; it does not prove universal correctness.
legend.implements: A program implements the cited mathematical construction; this is not a logical proof.
legend.limits: A scope, review, or current-document reconstruction boundary; not an additional mathematical premise.

nodes.title: Two-stage incidence model
nodes.detail: Positive atomic weights, two labeled facilities, finite allowed catalogs, mandatory patronage for covered customers, independent customer randomization.

nodes.title: Exact local customer NE
nodes.detail: For each common customer i, conditional cost difference is Delta+w_i(1-2p_i); endpoint signs and interior equality characterize exact NE.

nodes.title: Existential continuation criterion
nodes.detail: An on-path NE extends to alpha-SPE iff each coordinate is at least its true full-catalog deviation threat divided by alpha; off-path minima are independently selectable.

nodes.title: Ternary support cells
nodes.detail: Pure-1, pure-2 and mixer states give all local NE as points or, with exactly one mixer, closed intervals. The cells have rational endpoints when the input weights are rational.

nodes.title: Guarded pure repair
nodes.detail: A qualified pure seed reaches a pure NE in at most k moves while preserving the initial lower-load quota.

nodes.title: Strong chord exact iff
nodes.detail: In its reach regime, a two-load quota NE exists iff the largest common weight x satisfies x<=U-qV or C-x>=U-V.
nodes.status: complete manuscript and current Markdown, internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Polynomial strong-chord constructor
nodes.detail: Appendix A branches and Appendix B pair-local exchange jointly yield a quota witness in O((k+1)^4) rational operations with polynomial bit length.
nodes.status: complete manuscript and current Markdown, internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Three genuine mixers required
nodes.detail: Private loads 40,39 and three common weight-20 customers need probabilities (39/80,39/80,39/80) for both chord quotas.

nodes.title: Pair-local does not mean global maximum
nodes.detail: Historical box-slice example weights 14,13,19 at target -10 has pair-local objective 582 and global objective 654.

nodes.title: Rejected: every chord needs at most two mixers
nodes.detail: This proposed shortcut is false; Q1 supplies an exact three-mixer quota witness.

nodes.title: Rejected: pair-local exchange finds global maximum
nodes.detail: This strengthening of the needed local lemma is false; Q2 separates the two objectives.

nodes.title: Fixed P/E/T/C local menu
nodes.detail: P guarded pure seeds, E equal-reach halves, T designated two-mixer witnesses, C polynomial chord in its fixed reach regime. Menu u need not equal true m.

nodes.title: Full-catalog menu threats
nodes.detail: u(s,t)=min over fixed menu F(s,t); d_F(t)=max over every allowed site s of u(s,t). Both label orientations are retained.

nodes.title: No-witness cycle inequalities
nodes.detail: Assume no menu NE satisfies both q*d_F quotas. A maximizer response cycle then has the universal edge quantifier for all witnesses in its fixed menu.

nodes.title: Heavy pairs form an empty set or star
nodes.detail: Protected P witnesses and T pair witnesses exclude large atoms, triangles and repeated pairs on the normalized response cycle.

nodes.title: Second uniqueness: heavy-h transport
nodes.detail: Reverse-singleton bounds force h strictly to the responder and every other common customer strictly to the source, for all NE in the star/anchor branch.

nodes.title: Star/anchor/chord contradiction
nodes.detail: The star center, maximum-reach first edge, one/two protected anchors and precomputed C witnesses exclude every remaining finite bad cycle.

nodes.title: Shared-catalog phi existence
nodes.detail: For every finite common catalog and positive weights, an exact-customer-NE continuation selection supports a pure-location phi-SPE. The complete manuscript has undergone multiple internal audits; the current Markdown reconstructs all G1-G3 and L1-L2 branches.
nodes.status: complete manuscript and current Markdown, internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Bit-polynomial phi constructor
nodes.detail: For explicit incidence and positive binary rational weights, the complete manuscript gives O(|S|^2(n+1)^4) exact rational operations and polynomial intermediate bits to construct a certificate; current Markdown reconstructs the mathematical construction and local iteration bound.
nodes.status: complete manuscript and current Markdown, internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Exact-rational shared constructor
nodes.detail: Exact rational constructor and an independently implemented standard-library checker that recomputes conditional customer costs, actual deviations and all default tagged layouts.

nodes.title: Published golden-ratio lower bound
nodes.detail: IJCAI 2024 Theorem 5 gives weighted two-facility factor phi lower bound. Shared-catalog and rational interpretation needs a separate mapping.

nodes.title: Sharp shared universal threshold
nodes.detail: For every alpha<phi a corrected six-site shared-catalog positive-rational family has optimum exceeding alpha. The full 36 tagged layouts and a common rational perturbation radius are proved in current Markdown; combine with SC-PHI-E.
nodes.status: current lower and upper proofs internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Four guarded pure seeds
nodes.detail: At most four exact pure customer-NE witnesses per legal labeled cross-catalog pair.

nodes.title: Legal alternating cycle chords
nodes.detail: Both full-catalog response-cycle branches use only opposite-color legal pairs and four-seed witnesses.

nodes.title: Arbitrary-catalog factor-2 upper
nodes.detail: Pure customer continuations and bit-polynomial four-seed construction for any two finite catalogs. Internally audited candidate.

nodes.title: Four-seed pure solver
nodes.detail: Exact rational menu implementation; verifier now rejects illegal on-path and deviation locations.

nodes.title: Strict six-vertex lower family
nodes.detail: Disjoint 2-by-2 catalogs; weights (M,1,M+8,M+2,10,6), M>4. Four uniquely pure local games have optimum (2M+10)/(M+14), approaching 2.

nodes.title: Rejected: phi extends to all unequal catalogs
nodes.detail: The shared-catalog quantifier cannot be silently removed; H2 refutes the extension.

nodes.title: Sharp heterogeneous threshold 2
nodes.detail: Needs both the arbitrary-catalog upper proof and the strict lower family. Its lower instance is not a common-catalog instance.

nodes.title: Sparse short-catalog reduction
nodes.detail: Max pair overlap <=1, one catalog size <=2: 2-by-2 cubic cycle classification and retained best columns lift the upper bound.
nodes.status: complete current branch reconstruction internally checked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Sparse strict lower family
nodes.detail: Six-customer family approaches rho=2cos(pi/7) within the overlap-one, one-short-catalog class.
nodes.status: complete current branch reconstruction internally checked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Restricted sharp rho theorem
nodes.detail: For every overlap-at-most-one game with at least one catalog of cardinality at most two, a pure continuation yields factor rho. The strict 2x2 classification, ties, full-column lift, and rational lower family are reconstructed in current Markdown; both catalogs unbounded remains open.
nodes.status: complete current branch reconstruction, internally checked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Weak local extrema hardness
nodes.detail: Local NE threshold decision is NP-complete with zero private loads under binary integer weights; does not imply global phi hardness.

nodes.title: Three exact spectrum method proofs
nodes.detail: Integer pseudo-polynomial DP, distinct-weight fixed-dimensional ILP and exponential MITM have different scopes.

nodes.title: Bounded-overlap instance optimum
nodes.detail: Ternary support enumeration and threat/interval optimization compute alpha* in O(N1*N2*(n+kappa*3^kappa)) arithmetic operations.

nodes.title: Same-at-both quadratic equivalence
nodes.detail: For exactly two facilities with mandatory participation, a_i*z^2+b_i*z+c_i with a_i,b_i>=0 and a_i+b_i>0 preserves all local NE/CE/CCE constraints.

nodes.title: Cubic mixed-NE counterexample
nodes.detail: Private 1 and common weights 2,3 have a linear mixed NE that fails for cubic cost: conditional costs 90 and 86.

nodes.title: Rejected: all convex costs preserve mixed NE
nodes.detail: The same-at-both-facilities quadratic identity does not extend to all convex realized-load functions.

nodes.title: Conditional quadratic phi transfer
nodes.detail: Only if SC-PHI-E holds does the same output transfer to the specified quadratic customer costs.

nodes.title: 753 shared full-game checks
nodes.detail: 662 P, 88 E, 3 T, 0 C on path; finite exact certificate tests, not a proof.

nodes.title: Heterogeneous finite tests
nodes.detail: 2,406 four-seed and 500+1,500 menu certificates on sampled inputs; these test implementation behavior only.

nodes.title: External independent mathematical review pending
nodes.detail: Shared G1-G3/L1-L2 and the corrected six-site lower family have current proofs and internal review; external peer review or an independent outside reconstruction has not occurred.

nodes.title: Independent checker and on-path C coverage closed
nodes.detail: A separate standard-library CLI now checks conditional customer costs, deviations and all default layouts; a frozen three-site game selects a three-mixer C on path. These are finite engineering checks, not universal proof.
nodes.status: closed by independent instance checking and directed C fixture

nodes.title: Polynomial box-slice exchanges
nodes.detail: Pair-endpoint moves reach a pair-local quadratic maximum by a bounded pivot/flip routine; global maximization is neither proved nor needed.

nodes.title: Return rule: first all-NE uniqueness
nodes.detail: Under responder-exclusive mass E>R_s on the relevant return edge, every common customer strictly chooses the source in all customer NE. This is distinct from heavy-h transport.

nodes.title: Every contradiction witness is in the fixed menu
nodes.detail: The arbitrary-cycle proof uses only precomputed P/E/T/C equilibria, apart from two steps that establish actual all-NE uniqueness by strict dominance; it does not claim u=m.

nodes.title: Instance certificate completion
nodes.detail: On-path exact NE and exact NE at actual unilateral deviations satisfying factor alpha extend via a deterministic pure-NE default.

nodes.title: Six-site shared rational lower transfer
nodes.detail: Corrected six-site family: all 15 distinct-site and six same-site cases, strict NE and deviations, and a uniform positive rational perturbation radius are established in current Markdown.

nodes.title: Two-bounded subset-sum reduction
nodes.detail: Explicit SUBSET SUM to 2-bounded subset sum to local NE gap threshold, followed by a zero-private-load transformation.

nodes.title: Integer-weight pseudo-polynomial DP
nodes.detail: For integer common weights of total W and rational private loads: all gaps/extrema/quotas in O(n^2 W+n log n) arithmetic operations.

nodes.title: Distinct-weight FPT reduction
nodes.detail: For d explicitly listed distinct rational weights: local extrema/quotas via at most 2d ILP variables in 2^{O(d^3)} poly(n,L).

nodes.title: Exponential MITM exact local solver
nodes.detail: Arbitrary rational common weights: exact local extrema in poly(n)*3^{ceil(n/2)} time/space.

nodes.title: Strict lower bound approaching 2
nodes.detail: The six-vertex family has unique pure NE at all four legal pairs and optimum (2M+10)/(M+14), tending to 2.

nodes.title: Abstract response-core existence lift
nodes.detail: A cycle of full-action minimum-payoff responses induces a balanced core retaining full threats under independently selectable continuations. No efficient true-minimum oracle is implied.

nodes.title: Pure monotone-cost transfer
nodes.detail: For each customer, same-at-both strictly increasing realized-load cost preserves the pure construction and strict lower family; mixed correspondence is not asserted.

nodes.title: Explicit rational-polyhedral continuation theorem
nodes.detail: Nonnegative two-leader payoffs, independent continuation selection, explicit polynomial-size rational payoff-polytopes and effective realization yield polynomial LP optimization of coordinate threats and the optimal first-stage factor; realization cost is separate.

nodes.title: Full-action minimizing response core
nodes.detail: The cycle-to-balanced-square argument retains the full-game coordinate-minimum threats under independently selectable continuations.

nodes.title: Explicit rational payoff representation
nodes.detail: Each labeled pair has an explicitly listed polynomial-size union of rational payoff polytopes; nonnegative payoffs and independently selectable continuations are assumed, with effective witness realization for output.

nodes.title: Local DP finite tests
nodes.detail: 530 integer-weight DP spectra compared against exact ternary support enumeration.

nodes.title: Integer-weight spectrum DP implementation
nodes.detail: Pseudo-polynomial spectrum and witness routine; its verifier now rejects truncated probability vectors.

nodes.title: Single-overlap positive integer incidence family
nodes.detail: For every n>=2, two disjoint n-site catalogs with one customer at each occupied pair, positive private customers, all reach values of opposite parity and unique local NE.
nodes.status: explicit construction; internally arithmetic checked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Arbitrarily long exact-threat response core
nodes.detail: For every n>=2 a realizable single-overlap instance has a unique 2n-node full-catalog best-response cycle; no nonempty response-closed subset is shorter. Does not lower-bound the SPE factor.
nodes.status: current algebraic proof internally checked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Single overlap implies a constant-size exact-threat closed core
nodes.detail: The unconditional assertion is false for the explicit SPARSE-LONG-CYCLE family. Conditional compression under the absence of r-stable layouts remains open.

nodes.title: High-reach response subgraph is acyclic under no r-stability
nodes.detail: For arbitrary catalog lengths, single-overlap pure priority continuations and absent r-stability force every high-action full-catalog best-response edge to descend by labeled reach rank; all cycles visit a catalog-specific reach below maximum/r.
nodes.status: new direct proof and exact boundary attacks; unrefereed

nodes.title: Reach-balanced arbitrary sparse catalogs admit factor r
nodes.detail: If every row and column respectively has reach at least its catalog maximum/r, a complete pure exact-NE continuation and pure r-stable location pair exist for any r>=1; r=rho is a proper unbounded-catalog subclass of Q-SPARSE.
nodes.status: new direct proof and exact boundary attacks; unrefereed

nodes.title: Sharp rho for arbitrary sparse catalogs
nodes.detail: Every fixed tagged reach-priority pure NE rule has a rho-stable full-catalog layout under single cross-pair overlap and arbitrary catalog lengths; the H4 strict 2x2 family makes rho sharp even among all mixed continuation choices.
nodes.status: new complete direct proof, multiply internally attacked; unrefereed

nodes.title: Arbitrarily long genuinely r-bad sparse cycles below rho
nodes.detail: For each fixed 3/2<r<rho and each n>=1, rational single-overlap (n+1)x(n+1) games have unique local NE, no r-stable layout, and one strict full-catalog response cycle through every action; high rows reuse the same anchor client.
nodes.status: new explicit family and all-n algebra internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Genuinely bad long sparse cycles for every ratio below rho
nodes.detail: For each fixed 1<=r<rho and each n>=1, positive rational single-overlap games have unique customer NE, no r-stable layout, and one strict full-catalog response cycle through all 2(n+1) actions; high rows share one customer identity. New quantified version of SPARSE-BAD-LONG.
nodes.status: explicit all-subrho proof and internal independent algebra review; unrefereed

nodes.title: Balanced diagonal normal form
nodes.detail: Exact shared-catalog optimum and a complete attaining rule can use balanced customer equilibria on every colocated layout.
nodes.status: new complete current proof, independently internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Exact shared optimum via distinct-site overlap
nodes.detail: For positive rational shared catalogs, exact alpha and a complete rule in O(N^2[n+kappa_off 3^kappa_off]) rational operations with polynomial bit length.
nodes.status: new complete current proof, independently internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.detail: Every shared catalog of at most two sites admits an exact pure-location SPE for arbitrary overlap.
nodes.status: new complete current proof, independently internally audited; unrefereed

nodes.title: Exact SPE at equal site reach
nodes.detail: Every shared catalog with all site reaches equal has an exact SPE under balanced offdiagonal customer continuation.

nodes.title: Exact SPE for two reach levels with distinct-site single overlap

The local iff and guarded support geometry are made constructive by pair-endpoint exchanges and a polynomial pivot/flip bound.

The explicit objective gap refutes global quadratic maximization by pair-local exchange.

Menu minima and full-catalog threats give a sufficient two-quota witness criterion; u>=m need not be equality.
Failure of every menu quota witness implies all fixed-menu equilibria on response edges satisfy the normalized bad-edge inequalities.
Protected pure and pair witnesses constrain heavy atoms to an empty pair graph or a star.
Reverse-singleton P and heavy-pair bounds yield the second all-NE strict-dominance transport.
Star, maximum-reach edge, protected anchor and static C witnesses jointly contradict every finite bad cycle.
A surviving menu quota witness extends by independently minimizing actual deviation continuations to a phi-SPE.
The contradiction proves a witness inside the fixed menu; only then can enumeration and bit bounds yield the stated constructor.
A self-contained corrected six-site shared rational lower family and the universal shared upper bound jointly give sharpness; the published source is provenance, not an extra logical premise.
The original frozen batch of 753 exact certificates had no selected on-path C; later directed full-game coverage is recorded separately.

The strict unique-NE family approaches 2 and jointly matches the candidate upper guarantee.
The unique-continuation lower family refutes a proposed phi extension to unequal catalogs; SC-PHI-E remains untouched.
Strict 2x2 classification, tie perturbation, full-column lift and rational lower family jointly give sharp rho only under both restrictions.

The membership audit checks every witness in the cycle proof, including two true-uniqueness deductions.

Arbitrarily long strict unique response cycles exclude a uniform bound on nonempty full-threat response-closed cores, without refuting the rho approximation conjecture.
With at most one common client per cross pair, fixed priority pure NE and full-catalog best responses, no r-stable layout forces high outgoing edges to strictly decrease in tagged reach order.

hyperedges.statement: A finite functional response graph must have a cycle; when both catalogs are high throughout, conditional acyclicity forces a full pure-continuation r-stable layout.

hyperedges.statement: The exact long cycle has all actions high at r=9/5 but also an r-stable layout, so the no-r-stability hypothesis in the descending-edge result cannot be dropped.
The strict six-customer rational input has all columns high at r=9/5 but no r-SPE; requiring balance in only one catalog is insufficient.

A no-r-stable fixed-pure response graph has a first high-to-low edge; single-customer identity and the cubic q(rho)=0 exclude that boundary. The inherited strict unique-NE lower family jointly gives sharpness.
